purpose: Final production verification after Stage 4: read back the complete active Week 1 Graham board, verify the four live research tasks against repository authority, and dry-run a future-week rollover without advancing the live active week.

checks.requirement: Active 2026 Week 1 must contain 16 unique games; all exact/displayed fairs, generated decompositions, written summaries, home-field terms, personnel/matchup overlays, schedule metadata and market-isolation fields must validate from durable repository state.

TUESDAY_BASELINE, DAILY_REVIEW, DELTA_1645 and SUNDAY_PREGAME must be enabled exact-schedule ChatGPT tasks whose RRULEs match graham-schedule-metadata-v1 and whose prompts retain the active-week, Walters source, H4, personnel, M4, market-isolation and completion/read-back gates.

Create and resolve the next Graham week only inside a temporary sandbox, carry forward all 32 current team ratings, inherit repository schedule metadata into the simulated next-week board/research ledger, verify required file paths before simulated activation, and prove the live active-week manifest is unchanged afterward.

passRule: All three production-verification checks must pass against the same repository revision; the live active week must remain unchanged throughout.
